description.from: Ryan explicitly selected full cloud-native storage portability and rejected server-hosted SQLite. This supersedes checkpoint-only design. Preserve complete zero-cloud local SQLite behavior and Python/API/UI. Inventory every catalog/item/label/explanation/prediction/cycle/history/learning/job/lease/cache/session path. Shared backend contract, native SQLite parity, immutable S3 payloads and rebuildable DynamoDB index. Cloud coordination authority is undecided: approving a DDB index does NOT approve authoritative DDB CAS/counters/claims. Compare bounded canonical S3 per-run CAS ledger with additional DDB transaction authority before implementing either coordinator. First cohesive slice: shared decision batches, durable paid-attempt ceiling, cache generations/history and restart; all remaining authoritative stores must convert before hosted cloud mode can be enabled. Contract tests: concurrency/idempotency/pagination/scoped isolation/recovery/migration fidelity. Existing console account integration decision-flywheel-73a50b5e-7f10-4908-aed5-45f87e02da28. Preserve priming branches, no Kanbus issue encoding or TypeScript rewrite. No EC2 SQLite host, cloud resources/IAM/OAuth/deploy/public push; Papyrus remote/embedded initiatives remain separate planning.
